chains.title: CEBPB binds the T allele and increases SORT1 in hepatocytes

links.claim: CEBPB is the best-supported C/EBP-family candidate: CEBPB ChIP-seq peaks contain this variant in several non-liver ENCODE biosamples (E07), and rs12740374 is a known SORT1 regulatory SNP (E09a). The alt T allele is hypothesized to bind CEBPB more strongly because T increases SORT1 expression (E08), but direct allele-specific CEBPB binding is not shown. QBiC-SELEX coverage for CEBPB is not_checked because no QBiC-SELEX row or qbic_tf_detail lookup was provided.
The variant lies in the distal enhancer-like cCRE EH38E1374646, near CELSR2, PSRC1, and MYBPHL.

SORT1 is the strongest L2G gene at this locus and has a liver eQTL in which the T allele increases expression. However, SORT1 is 123 kb away and is not listed among E03 nearby genes, so direct enhancer-SORT1 regulation is not demonstrated.

The relevant context is liver, plausibly hepatocyte: a liver SORT1 eQTL is present (E08), a liver SORT1 sQTL credible set is reported (E05), and Hep 3B2.1-7 is the provided expression context. No Hep3B-specific ChIP evidence is available.

The G allele is the risk allele for higher LDL/high cholesterol in most GWAS entries (E04), so the T allele is protective; T also increases liver SORT1 expression (E08). The causal step from SORT1 to LDL/MI is not directly shown by these evidence IDs.

predictions: Allele-specific CEBPB binding is stronger on T than G at the rs12740374-containing enhancer in liver-derived cells.
CEBPB knockdown reduces the T-allele-dependent increase in SORT1 expression.
The T allele increases SORT1 expression in liver and is associated with lower LDL cholesterol.
falsified_if: Allele-specific CEBPB binding at rs12740374 is absent in liver-derived cells.
The T allele does not increase SORT1 expression in liver or hepatocytes.
Conditioning on rs12740374 genotype abolishes the liver SORT1 eQTL signal.

predictions: No allele-specific CEBPB binding at rs12740374 in liver-derived cells.

chains.title: CEBPB binds the T allele and alters CELSR2

links.claim: CEBPB is the candidate C/EBP-family factor: CEBPB ChIP-seq peaks contain this variant in non-liver ENCODE biosamples (E07), and rs12740374 is a known regulatory SNP at this locus (E09a). The alt T allele is hypothesized to bind CEBPB more strongly, but allele-specific CEBPB binding is not shown. QBiC-SELEX coverage for CEBPB is not_checked.
The variant lies in the distal enhancer-like cCRE EH38E1374646, with CELSR2 among nearby genes.
CELSR2 has strong L2G support and a liver eQTL in which the T allele increases expression, but direct regulation of CELSR2 by EH38E1374646 is not demonstrated.
CELSR2 QTL credible sets include liver and muscle contexts, but no cell-type-specific enhancer assay establishes which cell type mediates the effect.

The T allele is protective for LDL/high cholesterol in most GWAS entries (E04), and T increases liver CELSR2 expression (E08); however, a causal CELSR2-to-lipid effect is not shown by these evidence IDs.

predictions: The T allele changes CELSR2 expression in liver or muscle.
CEBPB binding at the element is allele-specific and CELSR2-linked.
CELSR2 expression correlates with LDL cholesterol independently of SORT1.
falsified_if: The T allele does not change CELSR2 expression in liver or muscle.
No allele-specific CEBPB binding is observed at the element.
The SORT1 eQTL fully explains the lipid association after conditioning on SORT1 expression.

chains.title: CEBPB binds the T allele and alters PSRC1

The alt T allele is hypothesized to bind CEBPB more strongly, but allele-specific binding is not shown. QBiC-SELEX coverage for CEBPB is not_checked.
The variant lies in the distal enhancer-like cCRE EH38E1374646, with PSRC1 among nearby genes.

PSRC1 has eQTL credible-set support and a liver eQTL in which the T allele increases expression, but the credible-set PIPs are weaker than for SORT1/CELSR2 and direct enhancer-PSRC1 regulation is not shown.
PSRC1 QTL signals are reported in pancreas and monocyte contexts, and a liver eQTL is present (E08); no hepatocyte-specific enhancer assay is available.
The T allele is protective for LDL/high cholesterol in most GWAS entries (E04), and T increases liver PSRC1 expression (E08); however, a causal PSRC1-to-lipid effect is not shown.

predictions: The T allele changes PSRC1 expression in a relevant tissue.
PSRC1 eQTL and lipid GWAS signals colocalize.
CEBPB binding at the element is allele-specific and PSRC1-linked.
falsified_if: PSRC1 expression is not affected by rs12740374 in any relevant tissue.
PSRC1 eQTL credible sets do not colocalize with the lipid GWAS signal.
No allele-specific CEBPB binding is observed at the element.

E09a only identifies rs12740374 as a known SORT1 regulatory SNP, not as CEBPB-bound. E08 gives eQTL direction, not TF binding.
